custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to whether the spigot and hose are physically plausible connected entities — AI often fuses them unnaturally. Also evaluate if the downspout diverter’s angle and position make hydraulic sense. Check for any ‘melting’ of the barrel’s lower contour into the soil. Do not overlook subtle texture repetition in the plastic ribs — a sign of generative pattern copying.
image_description: A dark green plastic rain barrel positioned outdoors between a white building wall and a wooden fence. The barrel features horizontal reinforcing ribs, a spigot near the base with a green hose attached, and a downspout diverter system at the top directing water into the barrel.
